assertions.assertion: Reads AuthorizationRequest.IdP on the login page and challenges that scheme
assertions.rationale: Reads context.IdP and redirects to challenge page for that scheme.

assertions.assertion: Checks the scheme exists via IAuthenticationSchemeProvider.GetSchemeAsync (which also resolves dynamic providers) because IdentityServer does not redirect or validate by itself
assertions.rationale: Says IdentityServer doesn't redirect/verify and uses _schemes.GetSchemeAsync(idp), noting dynamic providers.

assertions.assertion: Notes idp: can be combined with tenant: in acr_values, IdentityProviderRestrictions drop a disallowed idp, and idp:local is reserved
assertions.rationale: Notes idp+tenant combine, restrictions drop hint, idp:local reserved.
